title.narrative: IFRC - Toward Stronger Humanitarian Action in Africa through Advancing Effective Establishment and Operationalization of African Humanitarian Agency

description.narrative: The Danish contribution of DKK 1,000,000.00 to the International Federation of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies’ (IFRC) and the programme “Toward Stronger Humanitarian Action in Africa through Advancing Effective Establishment and Operationalization of African Humanitarian Agency (AfHA)” is a continuation of the support given in 2024 towards the establishment AfHA. The project is funded by Denmark, Norway, and Sweden with the aim supporting AU’s objective towards advancing local humanitarian action in Africa by placing emphasis on the need to strengthen local capacities to, anticipate, prepare, and respond in a coordinated manner to humanitarian crisis. Through financial support, the IFRC will engage with the AU Commission, the Humanitarian Division of Health, Humanitarian and Social Affairs Department to support AfhA’s establishment. The Danish support will be earmarked to (i) a consultation workshop for member states, focused on AfHA coordination and the development of guidance for reviewing DRM (Disaster Risk Management) frameworks; and (ii) continue support for the Senior Program Officer in order to ensure effective project implementation and facilitate communication between the IFRC and the AU.
